name: Icon Button
summary: Icon Button. Enhances a native button with a compact square action target, visual defaults, and a focus-preserving loading state.

lifecycle.compatibility: Supported contract; the documented compatibility policy applies.
lifecycle.rationale: Supported contract; the documented compatibility policy applies.

api.name: size
api.description: Named semantic size resolved through KERN density and sizing tokens.

api.name: variant
api.description: Named visual hierarchy treatment that preserves the component semantics.

api.name: tone
api.description: Semantic intent that selects coordinated text, icon, border, and surface tokens.

api.name: loading
api.description:
Suppresses duplicate activation and owns `aria-disabled` while retaining
focus. Use native `disabled` for ordinary unavailability.

api.name: loadingLabel
api.description: Accessible loading copy; defaults to the application or closest scoped option.

keyboard: Enter and Space dispatch the native click behavior
A loading icon button retains focus but suppresses click and form submission
notes: Every icon-only action has a native aria-label or aria-labelledby on the host button.
Native type, disabled, name, value, form, and aria-describedby relationships stay on the host button.
Loading uses a persistent polite status and aria-disabled without removing the action from focus order.
aria-disabled is reserved for the derived loading state; use native disabled for ordinary unavailability.
KERN avoids ambient browser globals in reusable runtime infrastructure.
Validate the consuming SSR/hydration route, locale, ids and overlay host.

examples.title: Accessible icon-only action

guidance.useWhen: Use <button krnIconButton type="button"> with a native accessible name and native events or form attributes.
guidance.avoidWhen: Do not add role="button", proxy native attributes through component inputs, or use Icon Button for managed toggle state; use Toggle Button.

commonMistakes: Importing from an undeclared family path or a source implementation file.
Loading only tokens.css instead of the complete styles/kern.css component bundle.
Assuming the documentation SSR build replaces validation of the consuming application.
Use button[krnIconButton] with a native aria-label or aria-labelledby; keep type, disabled, name, value, form, aria-describedby relationships, and click on the native host.
Use provideKrnIconButtonOptions for inheritable visual and loading-copy defaults, and prefer Toggle Button when the component must own managed pressed state.
checklist: Import the symbol from its documented owner entrypoint; do not use a deep source import.
Load @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css exactly once in the application's global styles.
Provide every required input and keep collection identities stable across updates.
Verify keyboard, focus, visible labels, invalid state, long text, RTL and 200% zoom.
Test the consuming SSR/hydration route when server rendering is enabled.
Use @kern-ui/angular/testing harnesses when a component-specific harness is available.
